newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal minister sees EDP price near 2,250 esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal minister sees EDP price near 2,250 esc.

text.p: Portuguese Economy Minister Augusto Mateus said he expected the price in the partial privatisation of utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal to be fixed near to the maximum limit of 2,250 escudos per share.

"When the level of demand is far superior to the supply, normally the price is at the upper limit. As there is plenty of demand for EDP and limited supply, the price should be close to the maximum level," Mateus told reporters after a meeting with a delegation of Saudi businessmen.

The share price and allocation in the privatisation of a 30 percent stake in EDP will be fixed after the close of Lisbon bourse on Monday and the stock will begin trading on the bourse on Tuesday. The price must be fixed in a range between 1,750 and 2,250 escudos per share set by the cabinet.
